anchor_pair_catalog_construction.canonicalization: min(sequence,reverse_complement(sequence)); sort distinct canonical anchors as a<b.
anchor_pair_catalog_construction.full_database_filters: Exclude pair if either anchor has stored count>200 in any discovery accession; require both anchors count>=10 in at least one accession.
anchor_pair_catalog_construction.mask: 4-bit mask in discovery-accession order; each bit requires both anchors count>=10 in that accession.
anchor_pair_catalog_construction.per_mask_selection: For masks1..15 in ascending order, retain at most64pairs by(rank,a,b). Pair IDs follow this concatenation; pattern IDs follow sorted unique selected sequences.
anchor_pair_catalog_construction.per_run_ranking: SHA256(seed + "|" + a + "|" + b); ascending(rank,a,b), keep at most128 unique pairs per run; first occurrence retains provenance.
anchor_pair_catalog_construction.whole_span_quality: All82bases must be ACGT and Phred+33>=20.

automaton_implementation.algorithm: Established Aho-Corasick exact multiple-pattern matching, implemented in C++17.
automaton_implementation.construction: Insert each canonical query and its distinct reverse complement into a four-base trie; build breadth-first failure links and propagate output lists; complete transition table with failure fallback.
automaton_implementation.counters: Per-read and per-physical-read-pair generation markers prevent repeated occurrences or both mates double counting a query. Group completeness is the set of all required query IDs.
automaton_implementation.scan: Read bases once; reset state on non-ACGT; output every exact occurrence including overlaps. Track last position below ASCII53 (Phred20) to mark every emitted window Q20 or raw-only.
automaton_implementation.validation_scope: Whole-run count invariants and EOF/read/base totals; direct independent oracle on declared bounded validation prefixes and retained examples, not a second full-production scan.

cohort_selection.algorithm: Sort the hexadecimal SHA256 of UTF-8 seed + "|" + PI accession in ascending order; discovery ranks1-4; holdout ranks5-12.

discovery_kmer_counting.warning: Stored zero in ci3 databases means raw multiplicity may be0,1or2. Full-sample count filtering includes discovery-prefix reads and is not an independent validation split.

evidence_definitions.discovery_signature_difference: Earlier CODE11 diagnostic signatures used a strand-normalized paired-string representation; they are not interchanged with ordered CODE20-25 signatures.
evidence_definitions.exact_span: Number of pairs with at least one mate containing target or reverse complement as a contiguous literal match.
evidence_definitions.pooled: Minimum across distinct required words of the per-word supporting-read-pair count; words may occur in different pairs.
evidence_definitions.primary: Q20, at least2physical read pairs for full catalog; thresholds1,2,3 bothraw/Q20 retained.
evidence_definitions.same_pair: Number of pairs whose mate union contains every required word.
evidence_definitions.same_read: Number of pairs with at least one mate containing every required word; qualifying pair counted once.
evidence_definitions.selected_case_signature: For60selecteddiscrepancycells only: SHA256(uppercaseR1 + newline + uppercaseR2 + newline); preservesmateorder and is not molecular deduplication. Raw/Q20 and thresholds1,2,3 retained.

historical_eligibility_dataset.citation: Mahamkali SS, Mangal H, Shrestha N, Xu G, Schnable JC, Yang J. Integrating SNP, RNASeq, and phenotypic data from sorghum association and diversity panels for comprehensive genomic analysis. Dryad; 2026. doi:10.5061/dryad.3j9kd51w9.
historical_eligibility_dataset.eligibility_reconstruction_scope: Original eligible table and deterministic ranking are retained. Eligibility depends on historical phenotype identity/design checks; this package does not replace that process with an all-400-SAP claim.
historical_eligibility_dataset.role: Historical eligibility by identifier/design and paired HN/LN phenotype availability only; no phenotype values used to rank accessions or association tests in this sequence-evidence study.

holdout_query_construction.near_full_alias: For647states of length82, near_full and k81 share the same native group; report labels do not create independent evidence.
holdout_query_construction.word_set: All distinct canonical k-windows of a target; order, spacing and within-target multiplicity not required by word-set rules.

observed_state_catalog.anchor_matching: Both orientations of all selected1190canonical31mer anchors.
observed_state_catalog.events: Within a single read, nonoverlapping frozen anchor pairs with gap0..80; every nucleotide of the anchor-to-anchor span must be ACGT and Q20. No mate-spanning distance is inferred.
observed_state_catalog.normalization: Compare forward tuple(left_anchor_id,left_strand,right_anchor_id,right_strand) to reverse tuple(right_anchor_id,flipped_right_strand,left_anchor_id,flipped_left_strand). Choose lexicographically smaller tuple; reverse-complement span and reverse quality string when reverse tuple wins.
observed_state_catalog.state_identifier: S + SHA256 of compact JSON serialization of the four-element state tuple (ensure_ascii=True,separators=(comma,colon)).

original_sequencing_study.article_license: CC BY 4.0 (article text); do not relabel sequence records with the article license.
original_sequencing_study.citation: Boatwright JL, Sapkota S, Jin H, Schnable JC, Brenton Z, Boyles R, Kresovich S. Sorghum Association Panel whole-genome sequencing establishes cornerstone resource for dissecting genomic diversity. Plant J. 2022;111(3):888-904.
original_sequencing_study.raw_data_reuse_statement: ENA/INSDC policy provides free unrestricted access and redistribution of sequence records with appropriate source citation. No whole FASTQ files are redistributed in this package.
original_sequencing_study.source_library_description: Original article describes paired-end Illumina NovaSeq 2x150-bp WGS from leaf DNA.

minimap2.limitation: At most50reportedsecondaryalignments and heuristic score ratio0.5; not exhaustiveuniquenessproof.2000bp bound is a setting, notmeasuredlibraryinsert.

reference_context.scope: Reference-only context; no full reference redistributed; no genotype or locus uniqueness assertion. Pinned assembly identifier rather than an inferred Phytozome version name.

release_reproduction_scope.public_runner: Reaggregate full catalog count tables, selected signature table and full synthetic performance table.

representative_cases.contents: Derived target/observed segment FASTA, event coordinates, case metrics and file hashes; no full raw FASTQs. Two-string phased case represents inferred observed-read-supported strings, not independent validated genomic haplotypes.
representative_cases.selection: Purposive explanatory examples from audited60-case ledger, not prevalence estimates.

scope: Recovery of executed methods and frozen public data identities for manuscript v1; no new sequencing analysis.
